text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—This year as well, the festival of 
Umamusume, the "Nippon Derby," has come to 
a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new Derby Umamusume and a historic duel 
were born, greatly electrifying the era, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having run with everything they had in the 
Japan Derby, Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro 
Ardan were both found to be injured after 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two were forced to enter a period of 
recuperation, leaving them sidelined from 
racing for quite some time—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, we'll be on our way.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for seeing me off. Yaeno-san, 
Bamboo-san, please take care of yourselves 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm waiting for Chiyono O and Ardan-senpai 
to get out of the hospital and come back 
to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. I won't be able 
to race for a while, but I should be back 
at the academy soon, so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I need to start training bit by bit for my 
comeback, so when the time comes, I'll be 
counting on you again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! Count on me for anything!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Please take care on your way. I 
shall... await both of your returns as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno! What's with that look on your 
face?! If you get that gloomy, those two 
are gonna worry!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me. ...My apologies, Chiyono 
O-san, Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still haven't fully come 
to terms with the two of you stepping away 
from racing, even temporarily—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――It's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With Chiyono O and Ardan-senpai, I just 
know they'll be back racing in no time!! 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we can have another epic, awesome 
showdown just like the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Believing in that, I'll do my best in the 
days ahead, 'ssu! So Chiyono O and 
Ardan-senpai, you guys fight on too, 
'ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Blaze up! Sakura Chiyono O!! Blaze up! 
Mejiro Ardan!! Embrace your 'dreams'! 
Fiiight!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. I'm sure that we can—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We can have a race like the Japan Derby 
again, can't we?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As long as that "dream" remains in my 
heart, surely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much, Bamboo-san. I 
swear that one day, out on the turf, I 
will repay the kindness of your words—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...They have departed, I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo-san, please let me thank you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for earlier.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Did I do anything that Yaeno would 
need to thank me for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's about Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san. I 
don't think I ever could have... 
encouraged the two of them like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I just can't forget it. That desperate, 
all-out run Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san 
showed at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And yet, with both of them suddenly 
gone... it felt as though a hole had been 
punched right through my heart... I felt 
an emptiness beyond words—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...However, you encouraged us. With your 
straightforward words, you encouraged 
Chiyono O, Ardan... and me as well."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"When you two return to racing, I want to 
do my absolute best to be worthy rivals to 
you both."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So that someday... I can run a magnificent 
race with all of you again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Kuuuugggghhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Friendship is the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno!! Thank YOU, too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm getting suuuuuper 
fired up toooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno and the others are shining so 
brightly! I can't let myself lose!! I want 
to stand right beside them!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's fire it up together! Our souls, the 
races, our "dreams"! Our whole 
generation!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Like a raging fire...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I'm aiming for it too...! For my own 
"dream," for the top...! I won't lose to 
Yaeno and the others!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Just you wait... Swan Stakes!!)
